name: MICROLN
recent: Microlink Solutions 获得内政部约 RM59.58 million 的合约延长，涉及移民局乘客预筛系统。公司于 2026 年 8 月完成 1 供 2 的附加股配售，筹集约 RM85.8 million，并发行 5.36 亿张免费凭单。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收同比大幅增长，但仍录得净亏损。
notable: 获得内政部约 RM59.58 million 的合约延长，为移民局乘客预筛系统提供服务。
完成 1 供 2 附加股配售，发行 536,198,072 股新股及同等数量免费凭单，筹集约 RM85.8 million。
将于 2026 年 12 月 1 日召开第 23 届常年股东大会。
risks: 公司涉及重大诉讼（MATERIAL LITIGATION），具体内容未在公告标题中披露。
最新季度仍录得净亏损约 RM5.67 million，净利率为 -3.2%。
附加股配售导致股本扩大，可能对每股盈利产生摊薄影响。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM178.2 million，同比增长 243.6%，环比增长 81.6%；净亏损为 RM5.67 million，净利率 -3.2%，较上一季度的 -4.0% 略有改善。

recent_en: Microlink Solutions secured a contract extension worth approximately RM59.58 million from the Ministry of Home Affairs for the Immigration Department's advance passenger screening system. The company completed a 1-for-2 rights issue in August 2026, raising about RM85.8 million and issuing 536 million free warrants. Revenue for the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026 grew significantly year-on-year, but the company remained in net loss.
notable_en: Secured a contract extension worth approximately RM59.58 million from the Ministry of Home Affairs for the Immigration Department's advance passenger screening system.
Completed a 1-for-2 rights issue, issuing 536,198,072 new shares with an equal number of free warrants, raising about RM85.8 million.
Scheduled its 23rd Annual General Meeting for 1 December 2026.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation, details of which are not disclosed in the announcement title.
The latest quarter remained in net loss of approximately RM5.67 million, with a net margin of -3.2%.
The rights issue enlarged the share base, which may have a dilutive effect on earnings per share.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM178.2 million, up 243.6% year-on-year and 81.6% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was RM5.67 million with a net margin of -3.2%, slightly improved from -4.0% in the previous quarter.
